tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS verification in development builds

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, so there is no build type in which verification is turned off. This sits alongside the recorded decision of HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so every connection, internal hosts included, uses HTTPS and has its certificate verified.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

Those two statements come from the current recorded decisions, #22 ("verification on all builds") and #25 ("https everywhere, no exceptions"). I left out the retired earlier notes (verification disabled in dev, plain http for internal hosts).
